description:
modules/workforce — GET /traeger/staff-pool/ (#4709) at a Träger with two
schools: the Träger's schools, the binding of the Träger transaction, its
release, the Springer of the week, the records with their links, the
schools that ever blocked them, the blocks of the week and the status of
the Nachweise in one statement each; then per school with an access entry
the binding of its tenant transaction (the entry itself is an insert).
Flat in the number of Springer, blocks and Nachweise.
